snippet.title: LEGO Racers: The Video Game - Nintendo DS Prototype Gameplay
snippet.description:
In late 2008, the next year’s LEGO sets were released “early” (which is not unusual for LEGO sets). What was unusual was the ad on LEGO Racers set boxes for the 2009 line-up had an advertisement for an unannounced game; “LEGO Racers: The Video Game“.

According to Brickset.com, this would have been the first non-licensed LEGO video game to be released since 2006’s BIONICLE Heroes. It would have also been the forth racing-centric LEGO video game to be released, after 1999’s LEGO Racers, 2001’s LEGO Racers 2, and 2002’s Drome Racers.

However, there was nothing else known about this game. No announcement, no trailer, no details etc. Not even a press release from The LEGO Group or possibly Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment. Years passed without any single word of it, and it wouldn't be until sometime in 2013, when a developer from Firebrand Games posted samples of work he’d done on the game, and stated it was unreleased. Included were four rendered videos (showing three car models and an animated minifigure), and two in-game screenshots.

From what I can tell, this game would have been released exclusively on Nintendo Wii and DS. But beyond that, the reasoning behind the cancellation remains a mystery. The footage we have here is for the DS version, whose build dates back to December 15th, 2008. This build has many issues with memory, and the game will crash often at random points, and no audio is played, despite it existing within the files. At least I still had the chance to record the gameplay on BizHawk.

LEGO Racers (C) The LEGO Group
